capabilities: Open the vault in a configurable terminal application
Launch user-defined shell commands from the command palette or ribbon menu
Manage multiple named terminal profiles per platform
Set each command's working directory to the vault root or the active note's folder
Control whether the terminal stays open after a command finishes
disambiguation: Not an in-app terminal emulator; it launches external terminal applications and runs shell commands outside Obsidian.
extras: Desktop-only (requires Obsidian 1.13.1+). README includes a security warning that configured commands run with the current user's permissions and should only be added if trusted. Windows launch behavior is restricted to cmd.exe, Windows PowerShell, and PowerShell 7; other executables are rejected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a terminal at the vault or run shell commands against vault folders.
summary: Desktop-only plugin that opens the vault in a terminal and runs configurable shell commands from the command palette or a ribbon menu.
